scope: Compared the full Japanese article and all twelve translations for technical meaning, branch/history terminology, command syntax, scope of downloaded data, dates, and links.
findings: Removed the duplicate future publication date; retained the original 2024-04-27 publication date and set lastmod to the review date.
Replaced the inaccurate claim that only the latest commit is obtained with the documented shallow-clone depth-one behavior from the selected branch tip.
Explained default branch selection and the implied single-branch behavior of --depth; added explicit branch selection.
Clarified that current files and required Git objects are still downloaded, so large current content can still make a clone large.
Added a fetch --deepen example and links to the official git-clone and git-fetch manuals.
